BMS:spectral-bound.used: The classical quadratic lower bound for a point set with a prescribed number of maximal secants through every external point.

conventions.requirement: The theorem is applied to the complement/minimal-multiple-blocking-set formulation.
conventions.matched: The manuscript derives the same cleared quadratic from the selected maximal-secants and explicitly identifies the variables under complementation.

LundSaraf:incidence-bound.used: The standard real incidence bound for a block design.

conventions.requirement: The incidence matrix is that of a 2-(v,K,Lambda) design.
conventions.matched: The symmetric design in Corollary 2.3 is a 2-design with the same parameter identity K(K-1)=Lambda(v-1).

MurphyPetridis:variance-identity.used: The classical equivalence between the second incidence moment and the spectral/variance identity.

conventions.requirement: Incidences are counted with unweighted point and block indicators.
conventions.matched: Every selected block and every point has multiplicity one in the real relaxation.

SWmodp:repair.used: Repair of a multiset with few non-k mod p lines to an exact k mod p multiset by changing boundedly many support points.

conventions.requirement: The plane is PG(2,p^h), h>1, and the number of exceptional lines lies below the theorem's threshold.
conventions.matched: The characteristic-three proof works along q=3^h and produces only O(q) exceptional lines, eventually below the stated threshold.

conventions.requirement: The repaired object is a multiset and corrections may have arbitrary nonzero residues modulo p.
conventions.matched: The proof uses only the number of distinct correction-support points and never assumes unit coefficients.

SWmodp:small-codeword.used: Exact representation of a sufficiently small-weight line-code word as a linear combination of ceil(w/(q+1)) distinct lines.

conventions.requirement: The plane is PG(2,p^h), with q>27 and h>2.
conventions.matched: The line-code obstruction is applied along q=3^e with e tending to infinity.
The centered norm bounds the residue-word weight by O(q), so the threshold holds for every sufficiently large q.

conventions.requirement: The representation uses exactly ceil(w/(q+1)) distinct lines with nonzero field coefficients.
conventions.matched: The proof denotes this number by t and, over F_3, takes the balanced nonzero coefficients in {-1,1}.

SWeven:repair.used: Repair of a point set with few odd-secants to a set of even type.

conventions.requirement: The projective plane has even Desarguesian order and the odd-secant count lies in the stability range.
conventions.matched: The characteristic-two branch has q=2^h and O(q) odd-secants, so the condition holds for all sufficiently large h.
